item.title: Charli xcx Directs the Action in ‘Camera’ Music Video Starring Vincent Cassel
item.description:
Here's a short, engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome back to Trending on Billboard! Today, we're talking about the one and only Charli XCX. She's been teasing us with her Music, Fashion, Film rollout, and now she's finally dropped the final single, "Camera".
[Short music clip plays]
Host: The song comes with a bold, black-and-white visual, directed by Aidan Zamiri and starring actor Vincent Cassel. In the video, Charli takes on a directorial role, bringing her vision to life on set. With lyrics like "I don't feel embarrassed even if I suck / I'm always craving an experience that feels dangerous", it's clear Charli is all about living life on the edge.
[Short music clip plays]
Host: "Camera" is the fourth single from her upcoming album, Music, Fashion Film, which drops on July 24th. The 11-track LP features an appearance from director David Cronenberg, and we can't wait to hear it. Charli's also making waves in the movie world, starring in the upcoming film I Want Your Sex, and gearing up for a North American arena tour starting September 11th.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. Charli XCX is on fire, following the success of her album Brat, which reached No. 3 on the Billboard 200 and won a Grammy for best dance/electronic album. We're excited to see what's next for this talented artist. Thanks for tuning in to Trending on Billboard!
